## Service: phone-system (LC Phone API v3)

API Service for LC Phone - version v3

### List active numbers
GET /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/phone-system/active-numbers | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/phone-system/active-numbers.md

List active numbers. With `version: v3`, the HTTP 200 body is the standard success envelope (`status`, `data`, `message`, `statusCode`). The v3 list payload is under `data`; `isUnderGhl` is renamed to `isUnderLc` per AIP naming convention.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: phonenumbers.read

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Location ID as string

Query parameters:
- pageSize number (min: 1; max: 1000; e.g. 50) - How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.
- page number (min: 0; e.g. 0) - The page index. The default is 0.
- searchFilter string (e.g. "+91") - Number search Filter
- skipNumberPool boolean (default: true) - When true, exclude numbers assigned to number pools from the list.
- includeRcsSenderIds boolean - Include RCS Sender IDs

Response 200 (Success envelope; v3 list details are in `data` (including `isUnderLc` instead of legacy `isUnderGhl`).) application/json:
- status* string (enum: success) - Outcome indicator from the shared success helper.
- data* object - V3 list payload: numbers, pagination fields, isUnderLc (renamed from isUnderGhl), etc.
  - numbers* object[] - Active numbers available for the location
    - phoneNumber* string - Phone number in E.164 format
    - friendlyName string - Human-friendly label for the number
    - sid string - Provider number identifier
    - countryCode string - ISO country code for the number
    - capabilities object - Phone number capabilities
      - voice boolean - Whether the number supports voice calls
      - sms boolean - Whether the number supports SMS
      - mms boolean - Whether the number supports MMS
      - fax boolean - Whether the number supports fax
    - type string - Phone number type
    - isDefaultNumber boolean - Whether this is the default outbound number
    - linkedUser string (nullable) - Linked user ID if the number is assigned
    - linkedRingAllUsers string[] - Ring-all user IDs linked to the number
    - inboundCallService object - Inbound call service metadata
    - forwardingNumber string - Forwarding number in E.164 format
    - isGroupConversationEnabled boolean - Whether group conversations are enabled
    - addressSid string - Address SID used for regulated number purchases
    - bundleSid string - Bundle SID used for regulated number purchases
    - dateAdded object - Date the number was added
    - dateUpdated object - Date the number was last updated
    - dateCreated object - Legacy created-at field returned by some providers
    - origin string - Provider origin for the number
  - isUnderLc boolean - Whether the account is managed under LC. Renamed from isUnderGhl.
  - pageSize number - The page size requested
  - page number - The zero-based page index requested
  - accountStatus string - Twilio account status for the location
  - rcsSenderIds object[] - Optional RCS sender IDs returned with the number list
    - number* string - RCS sender ID
    - numberType* string - Entry type
    - friendlyName string - Human-friendly label for the sender ID
    - rcsMeta object - RCS sender metadata
  - total number - Total number of active numbers when available
- message* string - Human-readable success message.
- statusCode* number - HTTP status echoed in the response body.

### List available phone numbers
GET /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}/available
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}/available
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/phone-system/list-available-numbers-for-a-country | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/phone-system/list-available-numbers-for-a-country.md

Search Twilio inventory for purchasable phone numbers in a country for the given location.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: phonenumbers.read

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Location ID as string

Query parameters:
- firstPart* string (e.g. "830") - firstPart is the beginning of the phone number
- lastPart* string (e.g. "825") - lastPart is the ending of the phone number
- anywhere* string (e.g. "825") - anywhere are the numbers required anywhere in phone number
- numberTypes* string[] (e.g. "tollFree,mobile,local") - comma separated types of phone number required
- smsEnabled* boolean (e.g. "true") - requested phone numbers should have sms functionality
- mmsEnabled* boolean (e.g. "true") - requested phone numbers should have mms functionality
- voiceEnabled* boolean (e.g. "true") - requested phone numbers should have voice functionality
- countryCode* string (e.g. "US") - country for which the phone numbers are being requested

Response 200 (Available phone numbers matching the search criteria.): no body

### Purchase number for location
POST /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}/purchase
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}/purchase
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/phone-system/purchase-number-for-location | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/phone-system/purchase-number-for-location.md

Purchase number for location. With `version: v3`, the HTTP 201 body is the standard success envelope (`status`, `data`, `message`, `statusCode`). The v3 purchase fields live under `data`: `number`, `locationId`, `id`, and `underLcAccount` (renamed from under_ghl_account).

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: phonenumbers.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Location ID as string

Request body (required) (application/json) PurchasePhoneNumberBodyDto:
- phoneNumber* string (e.g. "830236932") - phoneNumber to purchase
- addressSid* string (e.g. "ADXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") - addressSid twilio address id
- bundleSid* string (e.g. "BUXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") - bundleSid twilio bundle id
- countryCode* string (e.g. "US") - country for which the phone numbers are being requested
- numberType* object (e.g. "local") - type of phone number to be purchased
- paymentIntentId* string (e.g. "pi_3Oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") - stripe payment intent id
- stripeAccountId* string (e.g. "acct_1Oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") - stripe account id
- paymentMethodId* string (e.g. "pm_1Oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") - stripe registered payment method id
- locality* string (e.g. "Austin") - locality of the user in which number is being purchased
- region* string (e.g. "TX") - region of the user in which number is being purchased
- fingerprintId* string (e.g. "purchase-req-abc-123") - fingerprintId is request id which is unique for every purchase number request
- skipLocationKYC* boolean - Skip location-level KYC verification if agency-level compliance has already been verified

Response 201 (Success envelope; v3 purchase details are in `data` (slim shape: number, locationId, id, underLcAccount).) application/json:
- status* string (enum: success) - Outcome indicator from the shared success helper.
- data* object - V3 purchase payload: purchased number, location, Twilio account id, and underLcAccount.
  - number* string - E.164 phone number that was purchased (from the request body)
  - locationId* string - Location that owns the Twilio / numbers account
  - id* string - Twilio account document identifier
  - underLcAccount* boolean - Whether the account is managed under LC. Renamed from under_ghl_account in the legacy document.
- message* string - Human-readable success message.
- statusCode* number - HTTP status echoed in the response body.
